description: Atlas do Biometano para Portugal Continental is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Laboratório Nacional de Energia e Geologia - LNEG. The Biomethane Atlas serves to support the identification of sites more favourable to the implementation of biomethane production plants taking into account the proximity to biogas sources (potential producers), potential consumers and/or the gas grid. It is developed in GIS software for mainland Portugal. Coverage: Laboratório Nacional de Energia e Geologia - LNEG. The portal shows the English title as "Biomethane Atlas for Continental Portugal" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Laboratório Nacional de Energia e Geologia - LNEG. Its keywords include nacional, atlas, cartografia-oficial, len, biometano, informacao-geocientifica. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
